question: Total kitne orders hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question: Kitne unique customers hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers

question: 2017 mein kitne orders place hue the?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'

question: Abhi bhi kitne orders shipped status mein hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'shipped'

question: Sabse zyada customers wale top 5 states kaun se hain?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customers DESC, customer_state LIMIT 5

question: Sabse zyada kaunsa payment type use hota hai?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payments FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payments DESC LIMIT 1

question: Credit card payments mein average kitni installments hoti hain?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

question: Har saal kitne orders place hue?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Kaun si 5 product categories mein sabse zyada products hain?
gold_sql: SELECT product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products WHERE product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name_english ORDER BY products DESC, product_category_name_english LIMIT 5

question: Delivered orders ka average delivery time kitne din hai?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: Kitne orders estimated delivery date ke baad deliver hue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question: Average product weight (grams mein) ke hisaab se sabse bhaari 5 categories kaun si hain?
gold_sql: SELECT product_category_name_english, ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 1) AS avg_weight_g FROM products WHERE product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_category_name_english ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC LIMIT 5

question: Sabse zyada sellers wale 3 states kaun se hain?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY sellers DESC, seller_state LIMIT 3

question: Hafte ke har din kitne orders aaye (0 = Sunday)?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', order_purchase_timestamp) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday

question: SP, RJ aur MG states mein alag-alag kitne customers hain?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG') GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_state

question: 10 ya usse zyada installments wale payments ki average value kya hai?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_installments >= 10

question: Kitne percent orders cancel hue?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(order_status = 'canceled') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders

question: Total sales revenue ke hisaab se top 5 sellers kaun hain?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_id, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Kam se kam 500 reviews wale states mein se kaun se 5 states ka average review score sabse kam hai?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY avg_score, c.customer_state LIMIT 5

question: Late deliver hue orders aur time pe deliver hue orders ka average review score kya hai?
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 'late' ELSE 'on time' END AS delivery, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery ORDER BY delivery

question: Kam se kam 500 reviews wali categories mein sabse zyada average review score kis category ka hai?
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 3) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = r.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 1

question: Har purchase year mein items se total revenue kitna tha?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Kitne orders mein ek se zyada item hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: Kitne customers ne ek se zyada order kiya?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: SP ke customers ke delivered orders mein se kitne percent estimated date ke baad pahunche?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: IPL data mein total kitne matches hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_matches

question: 2016 season mein kitne matches khele gaye?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_matches WHERE season = 2016

question: Data mein kitne IPL seasons cover hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT season) FROM ipl_matches

question: Wankhede Stadium mein kitne matches hue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_matches WHERE venue = 'Wankhede Stadium'

question: Chennai Super Kings ne kitne matches jeete hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner = 'Chennai Super Kings'

question: Kitne matches bina kisi winner ke khatam hue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner IS NULL

question: Total kitni wides daali gayi hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_deliveries WHERE wides IS NOT NULL

question: Toss jeetne wali team ne kitni baar pehle batting choose ki?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ipl_matches WHERE toss_decision = 'bat'

question: Data ka pehla match kis date ko khela gaya tha?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(date) FROM ipl_matches

question: Kis franchise ne sabse zyada matches jeete hain?
gold_sql: SELECT winner_franchise, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner_franchise IS NOT NULL GROUP BY winner_franchise ORDER BY wins DESC, winner_franchise LIMIT 1

question: Har season mein kitne matches khele gaye?
gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM ipl_matches GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

question: Top 5 wicket-takers kaun hain, sirf bowler ko credit hone wale wickets gin ke?
gold_sql: SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM ipl_deliveries WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY wickets DESC, bowler LIMIT 5

question: Sabse zyada player of the match awards jeetne wale 5 players kaun hain?
gold_sql: SELECT player_of_match, COUNT(*) AS awards FROM ipl_matches WHERE player_of_match IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_of_match ORDER BY awards DESC, player_of_match LIMIT 5

question: 2024 season mein per match average kitne runs bane?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(runs_off_bat + extras) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id), 1) FROM ipl_deliveries WHERE season = 2024

question: Jin matches ka result aaya, unme se kitne percent mein toss jeetne wali team ne match bhi jeeta?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner IS NOT NULL

question: Sabse zyada matches host karne wale 3 cities kaun se hain?
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS matches FROM ipl_matches WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city ORDER BY matches DESC, city LIMIT 3

question: Ek match mein kisi batter ka sabse bada score kya hai?
gold_sql: SELECT striker, match_id, SUM(runs_off_bat) AS runs FROM ipl_deliveries GROUP BY striker, match_id ORDER BY runs DESC, striker LIMIT 1

question: 2020 se har season mein runs se jeetne ka average margin kitna tha?
gold_sql: SELECT season, ROUND(AVG(winner_runs), 1) AS avg_margin FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner_runs IS NOT NULL AND season >= 2020 GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

question: 2020 se har season mein chase karne wali team ne kitne matches jeete?
gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) AS chasing_wins FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner_wickets IS NOT NULL AND season >= 2020 GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

question: Kis franchise ne sabse zyada toss jeete hain?
gold_sql: SELECT toss_winner_franchise, COUNT(*) AS tosses FROM ipl_matches GROUP BY toss_winner_franchise ORDER BY tosses DESC, toss_winner_franchise LIMIT 1

question: Ek innings mein sabse bada team total kya hai, aur kis team ne banaya?
gold_sql: SELECT batting_team, match_id, SUM(runs_off_bat + extras) AS total FROM ipl_deliveries WHERE innings <= 2 GROUP BY batting_team, match_id, innings ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: Powerplay (overs 1 se 6) mein sabse zyada wickets kis bowler ne liye hain?
gold_sql: SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM ipl_deliveries WHERE "over" < 6 AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY wickets DESC, bowler LIMIT 1

question: Pehle batting karne wali teams aur chase karne wali teams ka win percentage kya hai?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN winner_runs IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS batting_first_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN winner_wickets IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS chasing_pct FROM ipl_matches WHERE winner IS NOT NULL

question: Kis bowler ne sabse zyada sixes khaye hain?
gold_sql: SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS sixes FROM ipl_deliveries WHERE runs_off_bat = 6 GROUP BY bowler ORDER BY sixes DESC, bowler LIMIT 1

question: Bat se bane total runs mein se kitne percent chauke aur chhakkon se aaye?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN runs_off_bat IN (4, 6) AND NOT COALESCE(non_boundary, FALSE) THEN runs_off_bat ELSE 0 END) / SUM(runs_off_bat), 1) FROM ipl_deliveries

question: F1 data mein kitni races listed hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f1_races

question: 2014 se Lewis Hamilton ne kitni Grand Prix races jeeti hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND position = 1 AND driver_name = 'Lewis Hamilton'

question: Italy mein kitni races hui?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f1_races WHERE country = 'Italy' AND NOT is_cancelled

question: 2023 season ki pehli race kis circuit pe hui thi?
gold_sql: SELECT circuit_name FROM f1_races WHERE season = 2023 AND round = 1

question: 2024 mein Charles Leclerc ne kitni Grand Prix races jeeti?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND season = 2024 AND position = 1 AND driver_name = 'Charles Leclerc'

question: 2023 ki constructors championship kis team ne jeeti?
gold_sql: SELECT team_name FROM f1_team_standings WHERE season = 2023 AND is_latest AND position = 1

question: 2025 mein McLaren ne kitni Grand Prix races jeeti?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND season = 2025 AND position = 1 AND team_name = 'McLaren'

question: 2019 ka Monaco Grand Prix kis date ko hua tha?
gold_sql: SELECT date FROM f1_races WHERE season = 2019 AND race_name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'

question: Race results mein kitni alag teams hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R'

question: 2014 se sabse zyada Grand Prix jeetne wale 5 drivers kaun hain?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND position = 1 GROUP BY driver_name ORDER BY wins DESC, driver_name LIMIT 5

question: Kis team ke sabse zyada Grand Prix podium finishes hain?
gold_sql: SELECT team_name, COUNT(*) AS podiums FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND position <= 3 GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY podiums DESC, team_name LIMIT 1

question: Sabse zyada races host karne wale 5 countries kaun se hain?
gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS races FROM f1_races WHERE NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY country ORDER BY races DESC, country LIMIT 5

question: Kaun sa driver sabse zyada baar Grand Prix mein classify nahi hua?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, COUNT(*) AS not_classified FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND NOT is_classified GROUP BY driver_name ORDER BY not_classified DESC, driver_name LIMIT 1

question: 2014 se sabse zyada Grand Prix podiums wale 5 drivers kaun hain?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, COUNT(*) AS podiums FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND position <= 3 GROUP BY driver_name ORDER BY podiums DESC, driver_name LIMIT 5

question: Har season mein kitne alag drivers ne Grand Prix jeeta?
gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT driver_name) AS winners FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND position = 1 GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

question: 2014 se sabse zyada races kis circuit pe hui hain?
gold_sql: SELECT circuit_name, COUNT(*) AS races FROM f1_races WHERE NOT is_cancelled GROUP BY circuit_name ORDER BY races DESC, circuit_name LIMIT 1

question: Driver ke classify na hone ke 5 sabse common recorded reasons kya hain?
gold_sql: SELECT detail, COUNT(*) AS times FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND NOT is_classified GROUP BY detail ORDER BY times DESC, detail LIMIT 5

question: Red Bull ne har season mein kitne championship points banaye?
gold_sql: SELECT season, points FROM f1_team_standings WHERE is_latest AND team_name = 'Red Bull' ORDER BY season

question: Kitne percent races pole position se jeeti gayi?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND grid = 1

question: Ek hi season mein sabse zyada Grand Prix kis driver ne jeete, aur kis season mein?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, season, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND position = 1 GROUP BY driver_name, season ORDER BY wins DESC, season LIMIT 1

question: Kam se kam 50 starts wale drivers mein per Grand Prix sabse zyada average points kiske hain?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, ROUND(AVG(points), 2) AS avg_points FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' GROUP BY driver_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY avg_points DESC, driver_name LIMIT 1

question: 2024 mein kam se kam 20 stops wali teams mein sabse kam median pit-lane time kis team ka tha?
gold_sql: SELECT team_name, ROUND(MEDIAN(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 3) AS median_s FROM f1_pit_stops WHERE season = 2024 AND session_type = 'R' GROUP BY team_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY median_s, team_name LIMIT 1

question: Har season mein kitni races pole position se jeeti gayi?
gold_sql: SELECT season, SUM(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pole_wins FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND grid = 1 GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

question: Kis driver ne total sabse zyada Grand Prix laps complete kiye hain?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, SUM(laps_completed) AS laps FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' GROUP BY driver_name ORDER BY laps DESC, driver_name LIMIT 1

question: Ferrari ke liye sabse zyada Grand Prix points (sprints chhod ke) kin 3 drivers ne banaye?
gold_sql: SELECT driver_name, SUM(points) AS points FROM f1_session_results WHERE session_type = 'R' AND team_name = 'Ferrari' GROUP BY driver_name ORDER BY points DESC, driver_name LIMIT 3

question: Crop production data mein total kitne records hain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crop_production

question: 2012 mein wheat ke neeche total kitna area tha, hectares mein?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(area)) FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Wheat' AND crop_year = 2012

question: Kisi ek district aur season ke liye sabse zyada potato production kitna record hua hai?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(production) FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Potato'

question: PUNE district mein kitni alag crops ugayi gayi?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT crop) FROM crop_production WHERE district_name = 'PUNE'

question: 2005 se 2013 tak har saal total wheat production kitna tha?
gold_sql: SELECT crop_year, ROUND(SUM(production)) AS production FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Wheat' AND crop_year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2013 GROUP BY crop_year ORDER BY crop_year

question: 2011 mein sabse zyada rice production wale 5 districts kaun se the?
gold_sql: SELECT state_name, district_name, ROUND(SUM(production)) AS production FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year = 2011 GROUP BY state_name, district_name ORDER BY production DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2012 mein total area ke hisaab se top 5 crops kaun si thi?
gold_sql: SELECT crop, ROUND(SUM(area)) AS area FROM crop_production WHERE crop_year = 2012 GROUP BY crop ORDER BY area DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2013 mein sabse zyada rice ugane wale districts kin 5 states mein the?
gold_sql: SELECT state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT district_name) AS districts FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year = 2013 GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY districts DESC, state_name LIMIT 5

question: 2013 mein India ki overall rice yield kitne tonnes per hectare thi?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(production) / SUM(area), 3) FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year = 2013 AND production IS NOT NULL

question: 1997 se 2013 ke beech kis saal total rice production sabse zyada tha?
gold_sql: SELECT crop_year, ROUND(SUM(production)) AS production FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2013 GROUP BY crop_year ORDER BY production DESC LIMIT 1

question: Har season mein maize ka per record average area kitna hai?
gold_sql: SELECT season, ROUND(AVG(area), 1) AS avg_area FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Maize' GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

question: Kin 5 crops ke sabse zyada records mein production missing hai?
gold_sql: SELECT crop, COUNT(*) AS missing FROM crop_production WHERE production IS NULL GROUP BY crop ORDER BY missing DESC, crop LIMIT 5

question: Kaun se 5 states sabse zyada alag-alag crops ugate hain?
gold_sql: SELECT state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT crop) AS crops FROM crop_production GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY crops DESC, state_name LIMIT 5

question: 2000 se 2005 tak har saal jowar ka total area kitna tha?
gold_sql: SELECT crop_year, ROUND(SUM(area)) AS area FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Jowar' AND crop_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY crop_year ORDER BY crop_year

question: Saare saalon ko mila ke sabse zyada wheat area wale 5 districts kaun se hain?
gold_sql: SELECT state_name, district_name, ROUND(SUM(area)) AS area FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Wheat' GROUP BY state_name, district_name ORDER BY area DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2005 aur 2013 ke beech kis state ka wheat production tonnes mein sabse zyada badha?
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT state_name, SUM(CASE WHEN crop_year = 2005 THEN production END) AS p2005, SUM(CASE WHEN crop_year = 2013 THEN production END) AS p2013 FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Wheat' GROUP BY state_name) SELECT state_name, ROUND(p2013 - p2005) AS growth FROM s WHERE p2005 IS NOT NULL AND p2013 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2013 mein Punjab ke total cropped area ka kitna percent wheat aur kitna rice ke neeche tha?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN crop = 'Wheat' THEN area END) / SUM(area), 1) AS wheat_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN crop = 'Rice' THEN area END) / SUM(area), 1) AS rice_pct FROM crop_production WHERE state_name = 'Punjab' AND crop_year = 2013

question: 1997 se 2013 ke beech kis saal total rice production pichhle saal se sabse zyada gira?
gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT crop_year, SUM(production) AS p FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year BETWEEN 1997 AND 2013 GROUP BY crop_year) SELECT crop_year, ROUND(p - LAG(p) OVER (ORDER BY crop_year)) AS change FROM y ORDER BY change ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: 2013 mein sabse zyada total cropped area wale 5 states kaun se the?
gold_sql: SELECT state_name, ROUND(SUM(area)) AS area FROM crop_production WHERE crop_year = 2013 GROUP BY state_name ORDER BY area DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2013 mein India ke rice production ka kitna hissa top 3 producing states se aaya?
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT state_name, SUM(production) AS p FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year = 2013 GROUP BY state_name) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(p) FROM (SELECT p FROM s ORDER BY p DESC LIMIT 3)) / SUM(p), 1) FROM s

question: Kaun si 5 crops sabse zyada states mein ugayi jaati hain?
gold_sql: SELECT crop, COUNT(DISTINCT state_name) AS states FROM crop_production GROUP BY crop ORDER BY states DESC, crop LIMIT 5

question: 2013 mein kitne districts ne 5 lakh tonnes se zyada rice produce kiya?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT state_name, district_name FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Rice' AND crop_year = 2013 GROUP BY state_name, district_name HAVING SUM(production) > 500000)

question: 2000 aur 2013 ke beech kis state mein sugarcane area sabse zyada badha?
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT state_name, SUM(CASE WHEN crop_year = 2000 THEN area END) AS a2000, SUM(CASE WHEN crop_year = 2013 THEN area END) AS a2013 FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Sugarcane' GROUP BY state_name) SELECT state_name, ROUND(a2013 - a2000) AS increase FROM s WHERE a2000 IS NOT NULL AND a2013 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY increase DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2013 mein Maharashtra ke kin 5 districts mein cotton ka area sabse zyada tha?
gold_sql: SELECT district_name, ROUND(SUM(area)) AS area FROM crop_production WHERE crop = 'Cotton(lint)' AND state_name = 'Maharashtra' AND crop_year = 2013 GROUP BY district_name ORDER BY area DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2012 mein Tamil Nadu mein coconut (jo nuts mein gina jaata hai) ko chhod ke sabse zyada production kis crop ka tha?
gold_sql: SELECT crop, ROUND(SUM(production)) AS production FROM crop_production WHERE state_name = 'Tamil Nadu' AND crop_year = 2012 AND crop <> 'Coconut' GROUP BY crop ORDER BY production DESC LIMIT 1
